theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_truncated_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ss j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (Ss j).massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c) → (∀ j, (Ss j).boundary = 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (Ŝ : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity C ∧ C.boundary = 0 ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => Ss (φ j)) C ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ŝ j)) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, ((Ŝ j).massOn W + (Ŝ j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn Ŝ C ∧ Tendsto ρ atTop atTop ∧ (∀ j, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (ρ j) ⊆ Us (φ j)) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 (ρ j) → Ŝ j ω = currentEval (Ss (φ j)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))
